A '''Sith''' was a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] around [[44 ABY]]. During that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] was chosen to be part of a strike team assembled to [[Mission to the Maw|capture]] the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] being [[Abeloth]] on [[Abeloth's planet|her planet]]. After arriving on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], the Sith, [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]], [[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]], [[Unidentified Sith 2 (Taalon's strike team)|another Sith]], and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] engaged Abeloth in combat. However, Khai accidentally [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Sith during the fight.

==Biography==
[[File:GavarKhai-Allies.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Gavar Khai, who accidentally killed the Sith]]
A [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who lived around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] was a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], a group from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]].<ref name="Allies" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> the Sith member was chosen to accompany [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]]'s [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|convoy]] of eleven [[ChaseMaster]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] to ally with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] for a [[Mission to the Maw|mission]] to find the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] being [[Abeloth]]. However, afterward, Taalon planned to betray and [[Death/Legends|kill]] Skywalker and force Abeloth to serve the Sith Tribe.<ref name="Allies" />

After arriving on [[Abeloth's planet]] and finding the being, the allied forces engaged her in combat. The Sith, along with Taalon, Skywalker, [[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]], and one [[Unidentified Sith 2 (Taalon's strike team)|other]] Sith, battled with Abeloth. However, she suddenly disappeared, and Khai's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] strike, intended to hit Abeloth, passed through the empty space where she had been a moment before and carved through the Sith, resulting in the Sith's death. As Abeloth reappeared and the battle continued, [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] [[Plant/Legends|vines]] began to rip apart the dead Sith's corpse.<ref name="Allies" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Do not worry, Commander. You have selected only the strongest and most powerful Sith for this mission.|Sith Saber Gavar Khai, to High Lord Sarasu Taalon, regarding the members of the Sith fleet serving under Taalon|<ref name="Allies" />}}
The Sith was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], and Taalon considered him very powerful, as the the High Lord had only chosen the strongest Sith to accompany him on the mission to Abeloth's planet.<ref name="Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith member appeared in [[Fate of the Jedi: Allies|''Allies'']], the fifth novel of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series, which was written by [[Christie Golden]] and published in [[2010]].<ref name="Allies" />
